out.detail: lower body injury, expected to miss fourth straight game

away.summary: The Predators (8-4-5) head to Los Angeles for a road matchup against the Kings. Jonathan Marchessault remains sidelined with a lower-body injury and is expected to miss his fourth consecutive game, while William Trudeau is out with an upper-body issue. Nicolas Hague and Ilya Lyubushkin are listed as scratched in the projected lineup.

out.detail: leg surgery, trending toward season debut Thursday vs Islanders

home.summary: The Kings (5-8-2) host Nashville after a 5-2 loss to Pittsburgh. Erik Gustafsson is day to day with an undisclosed injury, while Kevin Fiala continues to recover from leg surgery and is not expected until at least Thursday. Alex Turcotte and Samuel Helenius are scratched in the projected lineup.
